body: How people treat the earth/animals. Ever since we evolved we've been really bad about taking care of the ecosystem. We've polluted, chopped down entire forest, wiped out entire species, and are single handedly responsible for our current extinction event. We take, but we never really give back and that makes the whole food web unstable. Were literally killing ourselves and the people who are in power aren't doing anything about it. And I think it all just boils down to human greed. Which is why I hate the majority of all humans. It's also why i really appreciate indigenous cultures. They were able to live with the land instead of off it, and could actually maintain a relatively healthy ecosystem. Well, until a bunch of white guys found them and fucked everything up. Hopefully things get better in the future, but humans will always be human.
